title: Pipeline-Native Transformers: Co-Designing Model Architecture and CPU Inference for Bandwidth-Efficient Autoregressive Decode
abstract: arXiv:2608.23841v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Single-token autoregressive decode on CPUs is bound by memory bandwidth, not arithmetic: a modern CPU sustains roughly 1 TFLOP/s of compute but only about 50 GB/s from main memory, and each generated token must stream every active weight once. This report argues that the most effective response is to co-design the model architecture and the inference runtime together. It presents cflow, a CPU-first streaming engine, alongside a family of pipeline-native transformer architectures whose inter-layer dependency graphs are constructed to permit a vertical, stage-major execution schedule.   cflow stores weights as L2-sized tiles in compute-consumption order, reads only the top-k experts of each mixture-of-experts layer, fuses projections, and executes a delay-aware schedule from per-model dependency parameters. Across five architectures trained on TinyStories, one (arch2_4_combined) achieves a 2.00x reduction in critical-path weight bandwidt

translated_title: 流水线原生Transformer：协同设计模型架构与CPU推理以实现带宽高效的自回归解码
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23841v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在CPU上进行单令牌自回归解码受限于内存带宽而非算术能力：现代CPU可持续提供约1 TFLOP/s的计算能力，但主内存带宽仅约50 GB/s，且每个生成的令牌必须流式读取每个活跃权重一次。本报告主张最有效的应对方案是协同设计模型架构与推理运行时。它提出了cflow，一个CPU优先的流式引擎，以及一系列流水线原生Transformer架构，这些架构的层间依赖图被构建为允许垂直、阶段主序的执行调度。cflow将权重以L2缓存大小的块按计算消耗顺序存储，仅读取每个混合专家层的top-k专家，融合投影，并根据每个模型的依赖参数执行延迟感知调度。在TinyStories上训练的五个架构中，一个（arch2_4_combined）实现了关键路径权重带宽2.00倍的减少。
tldr: 通过协同设计模型架构与CPU推理运行时（cflow引擎），提出流水线原生Transformer，实现了关键路径权重带宽2.00倍的减少。
en_tdlr: By co-designing model architecture with a CPU inference runtime (cflow engine), pipeline-native Transformers achieve a 2.00x reduction in critical-path weight bandwidth.
